structure_en_model: The space is a rectangular living room, wider than deep, with a flat plain white ceiling at about 2.8 m and a continuous wood-plank floor with no level changes. Two wall planes are visible meeting at a front-left corner: the left wall carries a single full-height glazed window or balcony-door opening spanning most of its width, while the long right wall is a continuous painted plane with low skirting, a high wall-mounted split air-conditioner near the corner, a recessed distribution panel high up and a small access box lower down. Two round flush ceiling fittings are installed. The camera sits at 1.5 m with a 24 mm wide lens, two-point perspective toward the corner and a slight downward tilt.
